content: होमः [हु-मन्] .²1 Offering oblations to gods by throwing ghee into the consecrated fire, (one of the five daily Yajñas, to be performed by a Brāhmaṇa, called देवयज्ञ <ab>q. v.</ab>); इष्टिर्यागः . स एवासेचनाधिको होमः <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 8. 7</ls>. .²2 A burnt offering. .²3 A sacrifice; <ls>R. 3. 38</ls>; <ls>Mb. 12. 165. 26</ls>.
